description: Regulatory source candidate registry by market. Planning and research use only. Sources must be validated with test-source before enabling in sources.json.
validation_rules: Run: python run.py test-source <url> before enabling any candidate.
Only move to sources.json after extraction quality is confirmed.
Secondary intelligence sources must be clearly labeled as non-official.
Never enable sources with status=blocked or status=auth_required without an adapter.
